title: Verity Movie Ending Explained: Key Deaths and Plot Twists
text:
The Verity movie adaptation, starring Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson, delivers a shocking ending with three deaths and a major twist about Verity Crawford's fate.
The Verity movie adaptation, based on Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, has arrived with Anne Hathaway as Verity Crawford and Dakota Johnson as Lowen Ashleigh. The psychological thriller, set in New York City and Vermont, follows Lowen, an up-and-coming writer hired to complete Verity's unfinished book after a debilitating accident. The film, filled with jump scares and plot twists, ends with multiple deaths and an ambiguous conclusion that leaves audiences questioning what really happened.
Verity Movie Cast and Plot Setup
The story centers on Lowen's acceptance of a job to work on Verity's unfinished next book, as Verity has suffered a terrible accident that left her incapacitated. Lowen is invited to Vermont to live in Verity's home with Verity's husband, Jeremy, and their son, Crew. She ends up essentially living Verity's life, sleeping in the main bedroom, writing in her office, and eventually getting intimate with Jeremy. This arrangement leads to shocking turns as Lowen uncovers dark secrets about the family.
Who Dies By The End Of Verity
Technically, Verity features three significant deaths. The first is an unnamed man who is struck by a car on a busy New York City street corner, his blood splattering onto Lowen. This leads to Jeremy helping her get cleaned up and giving her his shirt. The second death is that of Jeremy and Verity's young daughter, Harper, who tragically drowned in a boating accident on a lake. The most significant death is Verity herself, who is violently suffocated on screen by Jeremy, who then dumps her body into the same lake where Harper died, with Lowen's help.
What Really Happened To Verity Crawford
The central question is what actually happened to Verity. Initially, Lowen hears that Verity is in a vegetative state after an accident. However, she begins to see Verity walking around and staring at her, suggesting otherwise. Lowen finds what appears to be Verity's unpublished autobiographical manuscript, which describes hating her twin babies, neglecting them, and intentionally killing Harper by tipping the boat over. Convinced Verity is faking her incapacitation and murdered her child, Lowen stabs Verity's hand with a thumbtack to get her to talk, but when that fails, she gives the manuscript to Jeremy. Jeremy reads the section about Harper's death and immediately tries to strangle Verity.
Lowen tells Jeremy to stop, leading audiences to believe she thinks he has gone too far, but instead, she instructs him on how to make the murder look like an accident. This shocking twist reveals Lowen's complicity and leaves viewers questioning the true nature of Verity's condition and the reliability of the manuscript. The ending intentionally leaves some things up to interpretation, as Verity has an unreliable narrator.
Ambiguity And Interpretations Of The Verity Ending
The film ends with Verity dead and her body disposed of in the lake, but the circumstances are complicated. It is unclear whether Verity was truly a monster who killed her daughter or if the manuscript was a work of fiction. The unreliable narrator element means viewers must decide what they believe about Verity's guilt and Lowen's role. This ambiguity has sparked debates among fans, with some believing Verity was evil and others thinking she was a victim of manipulation. The movie stays true to the book's open-ended conclusion, leaving audiences to ponder the truth.
Despite scattered reviews, the ending of Verity undeniably packs a punch, combining psychological horror with moral ambiguity. The star-studded cast, led by Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson, brings intensity to the thriller, which is far from a romcom despite moments of romance. The film's exploration of deception, murder, and unreliable narration makes it a standout in the psychological thriller genre.
